candidates.excerpt: Police have arrested a 41-year-old resident of the building on suspicion of murder; he is reportedly a Romanian national

candidates.title: Three held for MDMA peddling, consumption in Madhapur
candidates.excerpt: The Madhapur police arrested three persons for alleged involvement in MDMA drug peddling and consumption in Hyderabad. Police said one of the accused procured the drug from Bengaluru and allegedly sold it to another accused.

candidates.title: ‘Enormous potential’ for India-Canada ties amidst global uncertainty: Canadian Foreign Minister
candidates.excerpt: Minister Anita Anand is in India along with Minister of International Trade Maninder Sidhu for engagements with External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar and Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal; the Canadian Minister indicated that PM Modi would visit Canada later in December
